description: This file is a build script written in JavaScript (using ES module syntax). It orchestrates the generation of plugin SDK facade modules by importing helper functions and constants from other modules, processing command-line arguments, and managing output files. It includes functions to parse arguments, generate output modules, and execute the main workflow, which handles file generation and change detection.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine whether to check or write output, enforcing that exactly one mode is selected.

methods.name: generatePluginSdkFacades
methods.description: Main function that generates the plugin SDK facade modules and their type maps, handling output file writing or checking.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous entry point that runs the generation process based on command-line arguments, manages process output, and exit codes.
